initial_decision.brief_rationale: The population table and arithmetic checks do not establish causal identification. The archived design record is needed to assess whether standardizing over Z identifies the requested average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R296-3 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the population causal effect by standardization over Z. Stratum risk differences are −0.20 and +0.20; population weights are 250/350 and 100/350. Their weighted average is −0.08571428571428572.
